essence: A man freed from evil planets becomes healthy.
This marks the end of the third chapter of the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra.
By mere knowledge alone, all accomplishment arises.
This marks the end of the fourth chapter of the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra.
The speaker will properly explain how other men come under control.
